article.story: COOKEVILLE, Tenn. -- — Trent Mosquera had 25 points in Tennessee Tech’s 124-85 victory over West Georgia on Tuesday. Mosquera added five rebounds for the Golden Eagles (6-2). Davante Hackett scored 22 points while going 8 of 14 from the floo(4 for 6 from 3-point range) and added nine rebounds. Caleb Sanders had 14 points and shot 5 of 6 from the field and 3 of 6 from the free-throw line. Kenneth Chime finished with 18 points, 13 rebounds, two steals and five blocks for the Wolves (2-5). West Georgia also got 17 points from Chas Lewless, and Aleix Sempere had 11 points. Up next West Georgia: visits South Carolina Upstate on Sunday. Tennessee Tech: visits Eastern Kentucky on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
